# Proxmox VE (`proxmox`)

A Proxmox VE node and its VMs: VM and node power, status, stored charts, the VNC console of chosen VMs, and further hosts, through the API with a least-privilege token.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/proxmox`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/proxmox/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/proxmox/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `host`, `vm` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- HTTPS to the device, port 8006
- A websocket to the device, port 8006

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | API address | URL (https, http) | yes |  | https:// and the host's address with its port, usually 8006, and nothing after it. Plain http only on loopback. |
| `node` | Node name | text, at most 63 | yes |  | The node's name as Proxmox shows it under Datacenter. |
| `public_ca` | Publicly trusted certificate | true or false | no | `false` | The host's certificate chains to a public root, so no CA certificate is stored. Proxmox's own certificate does not. |
| `console_targets` | Consoles | a list of rows | no |  | The VMs that may have a VNC console. No other VM ever gets one, approved or not. |
| `console_targets[].vm` | VM | text, at most 32 | yes |  | A VM's local id: vm and its number, such as vm101, or a further host's id, a dash and that, such as two-vm200. |
| `host_files_dir` | Further hosts' files | text, at most 4096 | no |  | An absolute path: the only directory a further host's token and CA files may come from. Adding a further host is refused until this is set. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | API token | yes | user@realm!tokenid=uuid, as Proxmox showed it when the token was made. |
| `ca` | CA certificate | no | The PEM of the CA that signed the host's certificate. Needed unless public_ca is set. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.
